headline: EFSF: Greece repaid public debt of 2.5 billion euros
summary: Greece repaid 2.5 billion euros of public debt to the European Financial Stability Facility, according to the report. The payment is a debt service transaction with the EU bailout vehicle.
why: The EFSF is the euro-area bailout fund that lent to Greece, so repayments reduce Greece's official-sector debt and signal its fiscal capacity.
